publicItems.publicSummary: Governs knowledge, evidence, decisions and provenance so applications can project traceable results from a common semantic core.
Provides the operational view of Orange Peel company knowledge, services, standards and ways of working.
Demonstrates Orange Peel capabilities and use cases using governed knowledge and reusable APEX components.
Turns ideas, evidence and decisions into governed product requirements, designs, tests and engineering artefacts.
Presents Orange Peel products, applications and utilities directly from governed portfolio knowledge.
Provides a visual way to inspect governed entities, relationships, evidence and provenance held in APEX.
Transports governed proposals from Orange Peel applications and utilities into APEX Core without owning authority or persistence.
